# Draft:Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Duel

Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Duel is the second limited series under the Star Wars: Visions Presents branding, a spinoff of the animated television series Star Wars: Visions. The series will continue the story of the short films "The Duel" from Volume 1 and "The Duel: Payback" from Volume 3, which were written by Takashi Okazaki and produced by Kamikaze Douga and ANIMA.
